title: Blueberry Italian Soda
excerpt: Enjoy a refreshing artisan Italian soda made with homemade Fresh Pick blueberry syrup and sparkling water. A bubbly, eye-catching and delicious drink.
imageAlt: Tall glass with blueberry Italian soda, ice, sparkling water and fresh blueberries floating with mint leaves.
steps: In a small pot, combine one cup of Fresh Pick blueberries, the half cup of water, the panela and the lemon juice.
Bring to medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, gently mashing the fruit with a fork so it releases its juices.
Strain the concentrate, pressing the blueberries well to get a silky syrup, and let it cool completely.
Fill four tall glasses with plenty of ice and divide the remaining half cup of whole Fresh Pick blueberries among them.
Add 3 to 4 tablespoons of the cooled blueberry syrup to each glass.
Pour the very cold sparkling water into each glass, stir gently with a straw or long spoon and garnish with mint.
tips: High-mountain Fresh Pick blueberries grown in Guasca provide an ideal natural sweetness that makes the flavor of this artisan refresher stand out.
You can make the blueberry syrup ahead of time and keep it in an airtight jar in the fridge for up to a week.
If you prefer a creamy texture in the style of an Italian cream soda, add a tablespoon of heavy cream right before serving.
